description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named ChangedContacts that demonstrates how to query and display contacts and deleted contacts that have changed or been deleted since a certain timestamp. It manages loaders to fetch data from ContactsContract, stores timestamps in preferences, and updates UI components accordingly.

classes.name: ChangedContacts
classes.description: An Android activity that displays contacts and deleted contacts changed since a last timestamp, allowing users to refresh the data.

classes.name: ChangedContacts.DeleteCursorWrapper
classes.description: A CursorWrapper to map deleted contacts' ID column.

classes.name: ChangedContacts.DeleteAdapter
classes.description: A CursorAdapter to display deleted contacts with their ID and deletion timestamp.

classes.name: ChangedContacts.ChangeAdapter
classes.description: A CursorAdapter to display changed contacts with their ID, display name, and last updated timestamp.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components and adapters, sets click listeners for buttons.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers a BroadcastReceiver for contacts database creation.

methods.name: saveLastTimestamp
methods.description: Stores the last timestamp in shared preferences.

methods.name: getLastTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the last timestamp from shared preferences.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates loaders based on loader ID for fetching changed or deleted contacts.

methods.name: getChangeLoader
methods.description: Returns a CursorLoader to query contacts that have changed since the last timestamp.

methods.name: getDeleteLoader
methods.description: Returns a CursorLoader to query contacts that have been deleted since the last timestamp.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles loader completion, updates UI, and saves the maximum timestamp.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets adapters when loader is reset.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Helper method to set text on a TextView.

methods.name: buildText
methods.description: Creates a new TextView with padding.
